The team note says to skip the center, but the required assertion expects `[3, 4]` in the output. It can't be both, so I kept the center to satisfy the assertion. To follow the note instead, add `if (i, j) != (x, y)` to the comprehension, but then the assertion would fail.

```python
def get_coordinates(test_tup):
    x, y = test_tup
    return [[i, j] for i in range(x - 1, x + 2) for j in range(y - 1, y + 2)]
```

CONFIDENCE: 90
